DZA.note: A State Domains database allowing data exchange is mentioned, but no platform between public bodies' systems is described.

facts.fact: El Khabar reports that digital services have run on the national Fada El Djazair platform since 14 March 2024, including a pilot of online cadastral extracts.
El Khabar reports that nearly 7 million users have been served through Fada El Djazair since its launch on 14 March 2024.

DZA.note: No single sign-in or count of services is stated.

facts.fact: The Director General of State Domains called in April 2026 for full use of the Amlak information system in State property, cadastre and land conservation activities.
A pilot was launched at the Dar El Beida and El Harrach land conservation offices to issue cadastral and land registry extracts through the national digital services portal.
